name: @campuscast/contracts
description: Shared contracts: Protobuf definitions, OpenAPI specs, JSON schemas for Distributed Media CMS

scripts.contracts:validate: npm run openapi:validate && npm run schemas:validate
scripts.openapi:validate:strict: npm run validate:precheck && redocly lint openapi/gateway.yaml
scripts.schemas:validate:strict: npm run validate:precheck && ajv validate -s json-schemas/operations/schedule-op.schema.json -d json-schemas/operations/example-op.json
